Some clean price structure charts that I am tracking: A Thread on it 1. SCI (WTF) - Basing structure with VCP characteristics - Tight contraction near the pivot point - Each swing low is protected - Good volumes on the up moves - Above key EMA levels

2. APOLLO (2D TF) - Strong reversal from the lows - Increase in volume activity during reversal (positive sign) - Clean contraction/expansion phase (signs of strong demand) - Tight inside bar contraction ( slow accumulation/selling pressure weakening) - Above key EMA levels
